official_undefined_fields.policy: Preserve the official blank as an em dash, label it [需要官方确认], and never infer a description, scalar length, or conditional trigger from a same-named field.

undefined_conditional_triggers.integration_resolution: Conditionally required for every card_type accepted by the subject matrix.
Required/expected for card_type=1 private cards and not required for card_type=0 corporate cards; tolerate historical response absence.

official_ambiguous_semantics.ambiguity: The source says individual merchants/users do not support corporate-account or private-non-legal-representative types, while both enum 0 and enum 4 have corporate-account labels; it does not clarify whether enum 4 is excluded.
official_ambiguous_semantics.integration_resolution: Individual users accept only card_type=1; enterprise users may use 0/1/2/4 subject to the documented business conditions.

integration_decisions.authority: Integrator confirmation supplied in the task conversation; preserve separately from official field-table facts.
integration_decisions.successful_response_data: All five interfaces return a native JSON Object data on successful responses; the official N marker remains for source fidelity and abnormal-envelope compatibility.
integration_decisions.apply_query_fields: A successful query returns apply_reason, apply_status, and huifu_id for all Y/P/N/F statuses.
integration_decisions.business_open_apply_no: A successful user business-open response returns apply_no without implying final audit approval.
integration_decisions.interface_async_reference: Use the public interface asynchronous-notification contract; do not use the control-panel Webhook contract.

page_field_notes_preserved.note: Huifu performs real-name verification on the legal representative name and identity-card number.
Huifu performs real-name verification on the legal representative name and identity-card number.
When the certificate type is an identity card, Huifu performs real-name verification on the name and identity-card number.

official_incomplete_links.description: The interface row says to click for reference but supplies no link target.
official_incomplete_links.integration_resolution: Bind the full path to the official Basic Parameters bank-branch-code downloads supplied by the integrator.

official_example_shape_contract.algorithm: Decode JSON-looking string values, preserve array parents with [], and hash sorted source-key/direction/full-path records.

release_rule: The merchant 2,111-node catalog, five user-interface source digests and 354-node catalog, independent validators, and combined Skill package must pass before publishing huifu-merchant-onboarding 1.0.1. Previously published artifacts must never be overwritten.
